summary: Inventory guidelines: omit `[database]` when using an external database (which you must create, maintain and clear on uninstall), don't colocate the database or hub with controller, set `automationhub_pg_host`/`automationhub_pg_port` for `[automationhub]`, and use reachable FQDNs without `_` and never `localhost`.
questions: Can I install automation hub on the same node as controller?
Why can't my hostname contain an underscore?
Do I include [database] with an external database?
Can I use localhost in the AAP inventory?
